title: Pseudo-Gauge Stabilizers and Fibration Structure of the Cooper--Frye Map at Freeze-Out
summary: We study the pseudo-gauge transformation (PGT) freedom at freeze-out in relativistic spin hydrodynamics. The Cooper--Frye map is shown to factor through the quotient of freeze-out data by a universal stabilizer, yielding a stratified fibration over the space of thermodynamic Lagrange multipliers. This classifies observables into base and fiber types, bounds the number of independent PGT-sensitive observables by the family-restricted fiber dimension, and implies cross-observable consistency relations.
